headline: South African Exporters Face Heightened Risks Following AGOA Trade Program Exit
summary: South African agricultural, food processing, and manufacturing sectors face rising commercial exposure following the country's exclusion from the US African Growth and Opportunity Act tariff framework.
why: AGOA grants eligible Sub-Saharan African nations duty-free trade access to US consumer markets.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Loss of duty-free trade access under AGOA subjects South African exports to higher US tariffs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
